brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Generate exactly ONE finished landscape image, approximately 16:9, target 2048x1152 pixels, opaque PNG.
Primary request: Create a polished bold hand-ink basketball thumbnail about a pregame comparison of Tokyo United (東京U) vs Shizuoka (静岡) on 2026-10-29. Use only the editorial facts and exact text below.
Style reference already inspected in the conversation: B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Use its visual language ONLY: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry-brush diagonal strokes and ink flecks, warm ivory oversized heavy Japanese gothic headline lettering, a single orange basketball illustrated with vigorous black ink and brush texture. No text, dates, scores, names, people, poses, or numeric statistics from the reference may carry over.
Subject: One illustrated basketball and a few hand-drawn court lines in the right third. This article is not about one named player, so NO PEOPLE, NO FACES, NO HANDS, NO silhouettes, no jersey, no logos or sponsors. The ball is a symbolic still-life, not a depiction of an actual game moment. Do not add directional statistics charts or a victory motif.
Composition: Strong typographic hierarchy. Keep main text in the left two thirds, ball and sweeping lime brush energy in the right third. Calm near-black area behind all text. Generous safe margins of at least 5%. All characters fully visible, not clipped. No frames, no decorative panels, few elements. Each text string appears exactly once. Footer must be clearly readable. Do not cram.
Exact text, Japanese, with roles:
Small upper-left masthead: "バスケまとめ"
Small line below masthead: "2026.10.29 ｜ B.ONE ｜ 19:05開始"
Huge ivory main matchup headline: "東京U × 静岡"
Large lime second headline: "静岡のEFF更新"
Smaller ivory explanatory line: "登録選手の今季平均EFFを10/27時点と比較"
Clear ivory qualifier line: "試合前の独自分析｜出場・勝敗予測ではありません"
Small but legible bottom caption: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Small but legible bottom caption immediately alongside: "成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Editorial safeguards: EFF refers to registered players' season averages, not a predicted game score, not an actual result, not a team aggregate. No players are confirmed to appear. Do not show scores, player names, player numbers, individual EFF values, league-wide records, win/loss predictions, rising performance arrows, or a decisive shot. Render Japanese accurately and use only the exact text specified. No additional wording or watermarks.

generator.inspection: 生成ツールに表示された画像全体を目視検品。文字と数値、原稿の留保、人物不在、レイアウトと見切れ、AI表記を確認。PNGヘッダーと全チャンクCRCも検証。
